description: GET /v1/merchants/me/paymaster/overview/recent-ops - the merchant's most recent settled on-chain ops (chain, EntryPoint version, tx hash, sender, success, gas cost), newest first. Only settled ops attributed to this merchant for EntryPoint v0.7 and v0.8 - use paymaster_activity_list to see recorded attempts that never reached chain. Read-only.
name: paymaster_recent_ops
title: List recent sponsored ops
